needs.description: Complete adult maintenance dry kibble formulated for small/compact breeds with moderate-to-high activity. Small/mini kibble pieces for easy chewing by a 15 lb dog, protein-focused (e.g., 24–30% protein), moderate fat (10–20%), balanced vitamins/minerals. Available in 4–12 lb bags so portioning matches a 15 lb adult male. Consider limited-ingredient or novel-protein formulas if future skin/allergy signs appear.
needs.rationale: Daily staple — provides all required nutrition every day. At 12 months this Shar Pei is an adult with high activity and needs an appropriate caloric/protein profile to maintain lean mass and energy. Food is a consumable used daily and is immediately required.
evidence: standard: AAFCO adult maintenance nutrient profile

needs.family: Wet food or broth toppers (canned or pouch)
needs.description: Low-sodium adult wet food or savory broth toppers to mix with dry kibble — single-serve or small cans to add moisture and palatability. Choose plain, low-ingredient toppers (no onion/garlic) and small serving sizes suitable for a 15 lb dog.
needs.rationale: Adds hydration and palatability to daily meals — useful for preventing dehydration, encouraging intake on hot days or during mild appetite dips. Wet toppers are a daily consumable accessory that supports eating consistency and GI comfort for a young, active dog.
evidence: weather_context: multiple days with max_f up to 83.0 (warmer temps)
standard: feeding best practice for canine hydration and palatability

needs.description: Soft, small (pea-sized) low-calorie training treats for frequent reinforcement during walks/training. Easy to break into tiny pieces; high-value but low-calorie options to avoid weight gain. Packaged in resealable pouches for daily use.
needs.rationale: High-activity 12-month-old dogs benefit from frequent positive reinforcement during walks, leash training, recall and enrichment. Training treats are a daily consumable used during multiple short training interactions and walks.

needs.description: Standard-size dog waste bags (biodegradable or compostable options), on-roll format for daily walks. Strong seams, easy-tie handles, scented or unscented as preferred. Multipack to cover daily walks and small yard cleanups.
needs.rationale: Used every time the dog goes on a walk or uses the yard — required for sanitary waste removal in apartment/urban settings and small yard upkeep. Daily consumable and necessary for legal/sanitary reasons.

needs.family: Reflective LED collar or rechargeable LED illumination band
needs.description: Rechargeable LED collar or LED safety band with reflective striping sized for a 15 lb dog (adjustable, lightweight). Waterproof, multiple flash modes, visible at distance and during dusk/dawn. Secure quick-release buckle and proper size range for small/medium neck.
needs.rationale: Immediate safety item while walking in urban areas and during hunting season/low-light conditions. Hunting season and nighttime walks increase risk of misidentification or low visibility — LED/reflective gear reduces collision and accidental injury risk.
evidence: weather_context: days with varied outdoor activity (walks)

needs.description: Long-wear flea & tick preventative collar for dogs (12+ month protection depending on product) sized for a small/medium dog. Non-prescription topical/ collar option that repels/kills fleas and ticks; water-resistant.
needs.rationale: Seattle-area urban/wild interface and ongoing hunting season increase tick exposure risk. Preventative product reduces future parasite-driven skin and systemic problems; good practice year-round in many areas.
evidence: standard: parasite prevention recommended by veterinary guidelines

needs.description: Gentle, pH-balanced ear cleanser for dogs with folded/small ears — non-irritating, alcohol-free, with wipes or solution and cotton pads. Formulated to remove wax and debris without over-drying.
needs.rationale: Shar Peis have tight skin folds and smaller, folded ears that trap moisture and wax; regular ear maintenance reduces risk of irritation and infection. This is a preventive hygiene product appropriate for monthly or as-needed home use.
evidence: standard: breed-specific ear care best practice

needs.family: Skin-fold cleansing wipes or gentle antiseptic wipes
needs.description: Pre-moistened wipes formulated for canine skin folds — pH-balanced, antiseptic/antifungal safe, individually wrapped or tub. Sized for facial/nasal folds and body folds; fragrance-free options preferred.
needs.rationale: Shar Pei are predisposed to dermatitis in facial and body wrinkles. Regular fold-cleaning reduces trapped moisture, bacteria and yeast that lead to odor and infections. Useful after walks or when folds look damp/dirty.

needs.description: Mild, hypoallergenic dog shampoo (oatmeal or sensitive-skin formula), pH-balanced, suitable for weekly-to-monthly baths. Small-to-medium bottle sizes for apartment storage.
needs.rationale: Shar Pei skin is sensitive and prone to irritation; a gentle shampoo helps treat dry/irritated skin and manage flare-ups without stripping natural oils. Routine bathing can help remove allergens and environmental irritants.
evidence: standard: dermatologic care best practices for sensitive-skinned breeds

needs.family: Enzymatic toothpaste and dog toothbrush (finger brush or dual-head brush)
needs.description: Canine-specific enzymatic toothpaste (palatable flavor) and a soft-fiber toothbrush or finger brush sized for small mouths. Packaging suitable for daily/regular brushing.
needs.rationale: Dental care begins early—regular home brushing reduces plaque/tartar buildup and long-term periodontal disease. For a 12-month-old dog, establishing brushing habits prevents future dental problems.
evidence: standard: AAHA dental care recommendations for home care

needs.description: Battery-powered or rechargeable nail grinder with protective guard and low-noise motor for apartment use. Includes different grit attachments for safe grooming at home.
needs.rationale: Apartment living makes loud clipping stressful for both dog and neighbor; a quiet grinder eases at-home nail maintenance and reduces risk of over-clipping. Regular nail care prevents paw and gait problems.

needs.description: Adjustable front-clip no-pull harness sized for a small/compact dog (chest girth range to fit a 15 lb Shar Pei). Padded chest plate, quick-release buckles, reflective trim for evening visibility.
needs.rationale: High-activity dogs in urban environments benefit from a harness that reduces pulling and distributes force safely. Front-clip harnesses improve leash manners and reduce collar neck pressure for a breed with facial skin folds.

needs.description: Plug-in pheromone diffuser formulated for dogs (coverage suitable for an apartment). Refillable or replaceable cartridges for continuous home use; unscented/low-odor options available.
needs.rationale: Leaf blower season and Halloween doorbell activity can produce anxiety; a pheromone diffuser reduces baseline stress in the home environment and supports calmer behavior during stressful seasonal events.
evidence: standard: behavior management tools for noise/stress

needs.description: Adjustable, breathable compression vest sized for a small/compact dog (XS/S). Lightweight, machine-washable, with adjustable closures to provide calming pressure during noisy events or stressful walks.
needs.rationale: Useful during short-term noise stressors (leaf blowers, fireworks, Halloween). Compression vests are non-medical, immediate home-based calming tools that can reduce situational anxiety for an apartment dog.
evidence: pet_profile: activity: high (may be reactive during unexpected noise)

needs.family: Portable collapsible water bottle with bowl
needs.description: Lightweight, leakproof portable dog water bottle with attached collapsible silicone bowl. Single-hand operation, holds ~12–20 oz — sized for short neighborhood walks and yard trips.
needs.rationale: High-activity dog and warm daytime temps (up to low 80s) require on-walk hydration. A portable bottle supports safe hydration during outings and quick yard sessions without relying on home bowls.

needs.description: Durable rubber treat-dispensing toy sized for small/medium dogs — hollow interior to stuff with kibble or treats, erratic bounce for chase play. Appropriate for average chewers; not marketed as indestructible for heavy chewers.
needs.rationale: Provides mental stimulation and independent play for a high-activity 12-month-old. Dispensing toys lengthen feeding time and engage natural foraging instincts — useful in apartment when owner is busy.

needs.family: Interactive puzzle feeder or snuffle mat
needs.description: Flat snuffle mat or multi-level puzzle feeder that hides kibble/treats to encourage foraging behavior. Dishwasher-safe or easy-clean materials sized for small dog servings.
needs.rationale: Mental stimulation that slows feeding and increases sniffing/exploration — valuable in an apartment to channel energy and reduce boredom-related behavior for an energetic young dog.
evidence: standard: enrichment best practices for high-energy dogs

needs.description: Collapsible/compact flirt pole with replaceable lure — lightweight pole (3–6 ft) for indoor/outdoor chase-play. Replaceable heads and durable stitching; safe for average chewers and joints.
needs.rationale: High-intensity short-burst exercise that’s space-efficient for apartment living. Helps expend energy quickly in small spaces, improves impulse control and recall when used with supervision.

needs.description: Rubber or polyethylene fetch ball sized for small dogs (approx. 2–2.5 inches), buoyant, moderately durable for average chewers, easy to pick up. Bright color for visibility in small yard/park.
needs.rationale: Simple fetch sessions give structured exercise; ideal for daily high-energy play in small yard or on walks. Easy to store in apartment and used to burn off excess energy.

needs.description: Soft-but-durable tug rope with knotted handles sized for small dogs and human hands. Machine-washable or rinseable, non-abrasive for teeth.
needs.rationale: Interactive owner-dog play that builds bond and provides energy outlet; good for indoor play when outdoor exercise is limited.

needs.description: Self-cooling pad sized for small dogs (compact dimensions suitable for apartment floors). Non-electrical, reactivatable gel or phase-change material, machine-washable cover.
needs.rationale: Upcoming warm days (up to ~83°F) increase the need for cool resting surfaces indoors, especially for a breed with skin folding that can trap heat. Cooling mats improve comfort during warmer spells.

needs.description: Plastic or ceramic slow-feed bowl with maze/pattern to slow rapid eaters; small size suitable for kibble portions for a 15 lb dog. Dishwasher-safe and non-slip base.
needs.rationale: Slows eating, reduces gulping and potential GI upset; provides mild mental engagement during meals. Useful for active young dogs that may eat quickly.

needs.description: Non-slip silicone lick mat sized for small dogs; spreadable-paste foods or wet topper compatible. Dishwasher-safe and freezer-safe for extended licking sessions.
needs.rationale: Provides slow oral engagement that calms dogs during noise events or when left alone briefly; good for redirecting anxiety during Halloween/leaf blower disturbances.

needs.description: Lightweight, foldable exercise pen sized for small dogs; indoor/outdoor rated, quick set-up panels for temporary containment in apartment or small yard. Rust-resistant metal or heavy-duty plastic panels with secure locking latches.
needs.rationale: Provides a safe off-leash area in a small yard or inside when needed for enrichment, play, or when guests are present. Useful in apartment living for controlled free time without full confinement.

needs.description: Basic training clicker and a short target stick suitable for shaping behaviors and mental stimulation at home. Small, inexpensive, lightweight.
needs.rationale: Facilitates precision training, mental engagement and bond building. Especially useful for a young, active dog to teach impulse control and provide cognitive work indoors.
